name: Vacation
overview: Scripture teaches that rest is a divinely ordained principle established by God Himself, who rested on the seventh day after creation, setting a pattern for humanity to follow (Genesis 2:2). The Sabbath is commanded as a holy day of rest and worship, emphasizing the importance of ceasing from labor and honoring the Lord (Exodus 20:8; Leviticus 23:3). God's promise to provide rest through His presence (Exodus 33:14) reinforces that true refreshment comes not only from physical rest but from reliance on Him. Even during busy seasons like planting and harvest, rest remains essential (Exodus 34:21), reminding believers that their ultimate provision and peace come from the Lord, the Good Shepherd (Psalms 23:1).
